method: Two new first-party articles read through the complete extracted main text. No article bodies or source pseudocode retained. Prior-record URL-slug search found no mentions before this dated run. Runtime checks below are current documentation crosschecks, not executed experiments.

articles.title: Improving storage efficiency in Magic Pocket, our immutable blob store
articles.read_scope: Complete main prose, all seven sections, pseudocode and textual captions; diagrams not independently decoded.

practice.trigger: Background maintenance must keep resource overhead bounded as workload distributions change.
practice.problem: A policy efficient near steady state can leave a sparse tail consuming disproportionate capacity.
practice.mechanism: Select complementary strategies by distribution; bound planning, downstream work and locality; tune from fleet signals.
practice.limits: Rewriting data can move the bottleneck into metadata, bandwidth or user-facing I/O.
practice.counterexample: Increasing compactor concurrency may accelerate reclamation while degrading foreground latency.
practice.verification: Replay dense, moderately sparse and extreme-tail inputs; measure reclaimed bytes against I/O, metadata and latency budgets.

articles.source_limits: Proprietary implementation; production improvements are company observations. Source-specific thresholds are not portable configuration.

ranked_existing_reference_placements.reason: Extend measured-bottleneck guidance to background work, distribution shifts and budgets across downstream resources.
Use as a bounded worker/planner example; preserve the existing topology and completion contracts.
Add a distribution-shift scenario when a proposal optimizes average resource cost.

articles.title: Inside the Archive: The Tech Behind Your 2025 Wrapped Highlights
articles.read_scope: Complete extracted main article through lessons and credits; embedded architecture image not independently decoded.

practice.trigger: Independent results for one entity arrive concurrently, followed by an abrupt serving launch.
practice.problem: Updating one serialized collection creates lost-update races; cold reactive capacity misses a synchronized demand step.
practice.mechanism: Give independent facts disjoint storage identities; persist content before readiness; prepare and warm serving capacity before launch.
practice.limits: Disjoint writes do not protect shared invariants or make multi-record publication atomic.
practice.counterexample: Two independently stored reservations can still oversell one inventory quantity.
practice.verification: Interleave same-entity distinct-result writes, crash between content/readiness, and run the expected launch-shaped load after warmup.

articles.source_limits: Database product unspecified. Read ordering and routing must be verified for the adopted datastore; reported scale is source testimony.

ranked_existing_reference_placements.reason: Add schema redesign as a way to eliminate unnecessary shared mutation before choosing locks.
Add synchronized launch demand, scheduled capacity and end-to-end warmup to autoscaling analysis.
Use content/readiness ordering to require an explicit publication and repair contract for derived results.

current_primary_docs_crosschecks.read_scope: UCS workload tradeoffs, sizing controls, unsafe expiration warning and concurrent_compactors section.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.finding: Compaction settings trade read and write amplification; increased concurrency can raise foreground latency. Unsafe expiration can resurrect deleted data.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.implication: Validate the adopted engine's correctness boundary and every resource budget; Magic Pocket's strategy names do not map directly to Cassandra settings.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.applicability: Independent corroboration of the maintenance tradeoff, not a claim that Dropbox runs this Cassandra algorithm.

current_primary_docs_crosschecks.read_scope: Single/multi-cluster routing, row affinity and single-row transactions.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.finding: Mutations are atomic within one row and operation; multi-row atomicity is absent. Replicated multi-cluster routing is eventually consistent; row affinity does not guarantee read-your-writes during failover.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.implication: Writing content before a completion pointer is insufficient if reader routing may observe the pointer first. Use a compatible consistency/publication contract and repair orphaned content.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.applicability: Concrete adoption crosscheck; Spotify's article does not name Bigtable, so no datastore identity inference is made.

current_primary_docs_crosschecks.read_scope: Control-loop timing, algorithm readiness handling and pod-readiness guidance.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.finding: HPA evaluates periodically and handles initializing or missing-metric pods conservatively. Readiness and CPU initialization settings affect observations during startup.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.implication: Desired replica count is not immediately usable throughput. Validate detection, scheduling, startup, connection/caching warmup and downstream readiness against the demand shape.
current_primary_docs_crosschecks.applicability: General platform boundary; the exact source deployment configuration is unavailable.

new_skill_opportunities.trigger: Designing or tuning compaction, reclamation, rebalancing or index maintenance that competes with user workloads.
new_skill_opportunities.distinct_boundary: Distribution-aware job selection, resource-yield accounting and stable control loops across foreground/background budgets.
new_skill_opportunities.evidence_state: Candidate only; one deep article plus a platform-doc corroboration is insufficient for a general standalone skill.
new_skill_opportunities.initial_recommendation: Prefer the capacity reference extension now; collect independent rebalance/index-maintenance cases before proposing creation.
new_skill_opportunities.approval_note: User approval was conveyed by root after the initial reference-first recommendation. The original evidence limits remain applicable; additional procedural checks are independent engineering synthesis.
